name: com.retailreason/intelligence
title: Retail Reason Intelligence
description: Dated, confidence-classed answers to Walmart supplier, Sam's Club supplier, Walmart Marketplace seller, and broker or agency operating questions. Remote streamable-HTTP server. Requires an active paid Retail Reason plan: hosted Claude signs in with OAuth; Claude Code and Codex CLI send a per-person access key. Never connects to retailer accounts. Independent of Walmart Inc.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Retail Reason access key> for Claude Code and Codex CLI. Hosted Claude uses OAuth sign-in instead and sends no key.
